<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012024-12-1011-45-01" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone n="Colophon" unit="section"/>
        <lb n="78a7"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4791">yang dag rigs pa'i gsal byed <choice><reg>sgron ma</reg><orig>o°°°</orig></choice></rs> <choice><reg>zhes bya ba</reg><orig>zhes °°°</orig></choice> | bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byaM la chos kyi snang ba rgyas pa lung rigs kyi dbang phyug |
         thugs dgongs naM mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa dpal ldan <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3872">rtsang pa 'bre</rs> dang |
         sde snod 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag rnaM par dpyod pa'i blo gros 'gran zla dang bral ba |
         rje btsun 'jaM dbyang dang tha mi dad pa <lb n="78a8"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyal pa zhang tshes</rs> kyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos len pa |
         rnaM dpyod kyi rtsal gyis phyir rgol log lta'i dpung 'joMs shing ||
         legs bshad <choice><reg>rigs</reg><orig>°°°gs</orig></choice> pa'i thur mas blo gros gyi myig 'byed pa |
         btul zhugs la legs par gnas pa'i | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4025">shag kya'i dge' slong rdo rje 'od zer</rs> gyis <lb n="78a9"/> sbyar ba || 
         rdzogs s+hyo || dge bar gyur cig ||</seg></TEI>
